name: Pre-Flight Check
description: Initial equipment and suit verification before mission

tasks.name: Suit Integrity
tasks.description: Verify suit is in good condition

steps.body: Check all seals are secure and intact
Inspect suit for visible tears or damage
Verify helmet visor is clean and undamaged
Check primary oxygen tank is at 100%
Verify backup oxygen tank is at 100%
Ensure all oxygen connectors are secure

tasks.name: Equipment Stowage
tasks.description: Verify all tools and equipment are properly stowed

steps.body: Ensure all tools are properly secured in equipment belt
Check emergency beacon is within reach and functional
